what: Asterism's two-trait ML fit against native SOLAR, on real GOBS data
covariates: intercept, age at consent, age squared, sex, and the two products
transform: inverse normal (SOLAR inormal_), applied once in Python so both engines read the same values
note_on_age: age at consent is used for every trait so that one age applies to both members of a pair; the univariate run uses age at scan for the imaging traits, so those heritabilities differ slightly from it
redaction: Per-trait names and estimates removed before the repository was made public: they are unpublished GOBS results, and this record exists to state agreement with SOLAR, which the retained figures do in full.
